# Nadiane Bandola: Video Editor, Graphic Designer & Social Media Manager

> Intentional short-form video editing, motion graphics, and clean brand visual identities.

## Summary
Nadiane Bandola is a professional video editor, graphic designer, and social media manager based in Kabankalan, Philippines. She collaborates with international creators, e-commerce labels, and creative agencies across the United States, Australia, Germany, Canada, and the Philippines.

## Core Specializations
- Short-Form Video Editing: Dynamic 9:16 vertical video editing engineered for high retention on Meta Reels, Instagram Ads, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.
- Performance Ad Strategy: Creative variation testing, hook pacing, dynamic subtitle styling, sound design, and retention curve optimization for direct-response e-commerce brands.
- Graphic Design & Brand Identity: Amazon EBC and A+ Content infographics, social feed curation, marketing assets, and brand design guidelines.
- Social Media Management: Content planning, community engagement, publishing workflows, and cross-platform growth strategies.

## Featured Work & Case Studies
- Scooch (Tech Accessories, USA): Multiple short-form creative video ads including "Wingmate: Organization Queen (Hook B)" (412K views), "Moneymate: Unboxing All Designs" (348K views), and "Moneymate: Pinterest Perfect Cut" (219K views).
- Brooke Lewis (Creator Studio, Sydney, Australia): Reels and Stories editor focusing on high-engagement lifestyle creator content.
- Legends in Seconds (Short-Form Network, Philippines): Social media manager and YouTube Shorts editor.
- The Birdie Agency (Creative Agency, Australia): Lead video editor for client video campaigns.
- Nifora (E-Commerce, Germany): Short-form video editor for direct-response product marketing.
- GChrom Media Services (Production House, Canada): Shorts video editor.
- Damon Crowdy Foundation (Non-Profit, USA): Lead graphic designer for community and donor engagement.
- Rebirth Enhancement (Aesthetic Brand Services, Philippines): Brand graphic designer for visual identity and campaigns.

## Technical Toolkit
- Video Editing: Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, DaVinci Resolve
- Motion Graphics: Adobe After Effects
- Graphic Design: Adobe Photoshop, Figma, Canva
- Social & Strategy: Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Studio, YouTube Studio

## Education & Background
- Degree: Bachelor of Science in Medical Technology
- Institution: Colegio San Agustin (Bacolod, Philippines, 2020 to 2024)
- Note: Her clinical laboratory background in microscopy and forensic analysis directly informs her data-driven, detail-oriented approach to video retention metrics and creative A/B testing.
